name: agent-canvas
description: Clone-and-run local web canvas and MCP server for agent-created boards.

scripts.setup: npm run deps:materialize && npm ci && npm run check:internal-deps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-sdk && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-testkit && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/extension-sdk && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/extension-testkit && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/core && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/editor && npm run build --workspace create-agentcanvas-plugin && npm run build --workspace create-agentcanvas-extension
scripts.build:plugins: npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-assets2 && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-filesystem-images && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-gallery && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-glb-viewer && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-image-overlays && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-markdown && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-primitives && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-table && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/plugin-video && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/extension-diagrams && npm run build --workspace @agentcanvas/extension-mediatools
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.plugins:build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:plugins && tsx src/cli/plugins-main.ts catalog
scripts.test: npm run plugins:build && npm run check:packages && npm run test:packages && npm run test:external-plugin && vitest run
scripts.test:external-plugin: npm --prefix test/external-plugin-fixture run check && npm --prefix test/external-plugin-fixture test && npm --prefix test/external-plugin-fixture run pack:plugin && npm --prefix test/external-plugin-fixture run agentcanvas:verify
scripts.test:e2e: npm run plugins:build && vite build && playwright test --config test/e2e/playwright.config.ts
